summary: Provides alternative ASN.1 modules for the Evidence Record Syntax and its use in the Server-based Certificate Validation Protocol. The new modules use the 2002 version of ASN.1 and follow the conventions of RFC 5911, RFC 5912, and RFC 6268. Nothing changes on the wire, only the syntax description. It is informational.

eli5.summary: The same message is written in a newer spelling style. The message itself is exactly the same.
